shortDescription: WINDSOR, Ontario, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NEXE Innovations Inc. ("NEXE", the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") (TSX.V: NEXE) Frankfurt:NX5 OTC:NEXNF, a compostable and innovative materials company, is pleased to announce its financial results for the three-month period ended August 31, 2026…

children: WINDSOR, Ontario, Oct. 30, 2026
-- NEXE Innovations Inc. ("NEXE", the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") (TSX.V: NEXE)
Frankfurt:NX5
, a compostable and innovative materials company, is pleased to announce its financial results for the three-month period ended August 31, 2026 ("Q1 2027").

NEXE grew revenue 10.5% to $133,119 in Q1 2027 from $120,484 in Q1 2026, in a quarter that has, in management's view, been historically seasonally soft for the North American coffee industry, and reduced its net loss 33.7% to $(946,396). During the quarter, NEXE began deliveries to an East Coast fair-trade organic coffee co-operative that previously had no single-serve offering and onboarded a U.S. coffee chain with locations in New York City and Boston. Based on current customer interest and commercial opportunities in progress, management currently expects annual pod volumes to exceed the upper end of the previously announced range of 10 to 15 million compostable coffee pods.

Results for the quarter also reflect higher costs. Gross loss was $(47,552), compared to gross income of $16,453 in the three-month period ended August 31, 2025 ("Q1 2026"), and the net loss improvement was, in management's view, primarily attributable to lower depreciation, including the effect of a change in depreciation estimates.
Q1 2027 Highlights
Revenue:
$133,119, up 10.5% from $120,484 in Q1 2026, in a quarter that has historically been seasonally soft.
Net loss:
$(946,396), or $(0.01) per share, an improvement of 33.7%, with total operating expenses down 37.4%.
Customers:
Deliveries began to Just Us! Coffee Roasters, a U.S. coffee chain was onboarded, and the Company is in discussions with a U.S. brand regarding potential distribution to a national hotel chain.
Volume outlook:

Based on current customer interest and commercial opportunities in progress, management currently expects annual pod volumes to exceed the upper end of the previously announced range of 10 to 15 million pods.
Liquidity:
Cash, cash equivalents, GICs and term deposits of $8,008,095 and working capital of $7,693,960.
"Revenue grew 10.5% in what has historically been a seasonally soft quarter, and we began deliveries to new customers during the period,"
said Ash Guglani, President of NEXE

. "Gross margin in the quarter reflected the costs of onboarding those customers, which we believe may trend lower as volumes build. Our focus for the rest of fiscal 2027 is to convert our commercial pipeline into production volume."
Q1 2027 Financial Results
Revenue Growth:

Revenue was $133,119, compared to $120,484 in Q1 2026, reflecting repeat orders from existing customers and new customers onboarded during the quarter. Shipments were weighted to July and August 2026. The first quarter has historically been seasonally weak, and management believes coffee sales across the industry typically decline during the summer months.
Gross Margin:

Gross loss was $(47,552), compared to gross income of $16,453 in Q1 2026, as cost of goods sold increased 73.7% to $180,671 from $104,031. Management believes the increase reflects higher volumes, onboarding costs for new customers, higher packaging costs, a larger share of pods filled with coffee purchased by the Company, $54,742 of non-cash production depreciation (recorded in operating expenses in Q1 2026) and $10,685 of inventory write-downs. Management expects that costs will trend lower as volumes increase, as management expects higher volumes will help absorb fixed costs and support bulk purchasing of materials.
Operating Expenses:

Total operating expenses decreased 37.4% to $950,956 from $1,520,057, and operating loss before other items improved 33.6% to $(998,508) from $(1,503,604). Depreciation in operating expenses decreased 75.9% to $108,103. Effective June 1, 2026, the Company extended the estimated useful lives of its metered production machinery and changed the depreciation method from straight-line to units of use, which reduced Q1 2027 depreciation by $269,353 relative to the previous estimates. Share-based compensation decreased 94.0% to $13,187 and research and development expenses decreased 67.7% to $33,447. Selling, general and administrative expenses increased 7.4% to $790,139, mainly due to higher compensation-related costs and higher legal and professional fees, partially offset by lower management fees, salaries, consulting fees, and advertising and promotion.
Net Loss:

Net loss improved 33.7% to $(946,396), or $(0.01) per share, from $(1,427,807), or $(0.01) per share, in Q1 2026. The $481,411 improvement reflects lower depreciation, share-based compensation and research and development expenses, partially offset by the gross loss, higher selling, general and administrative expenses, and lower interest income.
Balance Sheet:

As at August 31, 2026, NEXE had cash and cash equivalents of $3,875,352, investments in GICs of $4,102,743 and term deposits of $30,000, for a total of $8,008,095. Working capital was $7,693,960 (May 31, 2026 – $8,464,675), or $6.0 million excluding $1.7 million of prepayments on manufacturing equipment. Cash used in operating activities was $1,096,265 (Q1 2026 – $760,265), mainly reflecting operating expenditures and working capital movements, including a reduction in trade and other payables and an increase in trade and other receivables.
Commercial Update: Management Expects Annual Pod Volumes to Exceed 15 Million

NEXE supplied partners across retail, office coffee services and online channels during Q1 2027, and the previously disclosed partner transition continued through the quarter. NEXE continues to see increased interest in the compostable pod.

During the quarter, NEXE began deliveries to Just Us! Coffee Roasters, an East Coast fair-trade organic coffee co-operative that previously had no single-serve offering, and onboarded a U.S. coffee chain with multiple locations, including New York City and Boston. NEXE is in discussions with a U.S. brand regarding the potential supply of pods for distribution to a national hotel chain and is procuring materials for a new Canadian client.

Management currently expects annual pod volumes to exceed 15 million compostable coffee pods. NEXE anticipates current finished goods capacity aligns with expected production for the coming months and that capacity could be scaled with limited additional investment, such as larger molds or additional staff. The Company is also evaluating strategic opportunities that management anticipates would accelerate commercialization and enhance shareholder value, including potential partnerships, licensing arrangements, and other capital-efficient growth initiatives.

About NEXE Innovations Inc.

NEXE Innovations is focused on providing innovative compostable material solutions and packaging to the B2B segment to help businesses achieve their sustainability goals. NEXE Innovations has developed a proprietary and patented compostable material that can withstand heat, pressure, and water. Our flagship product, the NEXE Pod, a BPI-certified compostable coffee pod, showcases our material's durability and is an ideal substitute for plastic. The NEXE pod is compatible with major coffee brewing machines and is manufactured at NEXE's vertically integrated facility based in North America. Discover our innovative approach to sustainability at www.nexeinnovations.com and join our journey on social media @nexeinnovations. #compostablecoffeepods #sustainability #greentech
